What the W123 is allowed to do

The car has no emissions label in any system, so the limits are access zones in Madrid, Bilbao, San Sebastián, the French ZFE cities and the whole of Florence. Vignettes are needed only in Slovenia and Romania. This is a snapshot; the live tracker ↗ is where changes get made.
